briefing.headline: BRAI rockets 29% as small‑cap surge dominates overnight
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech names posted modest gains, with AMD up 1.8%, GOOGL up 1.0% and NVDA up 0.9%, while the broader indices were flat (SPY +0.15%). The market breadth was positive (7 advancers vs 3 decliners) but the headline moves came from smaller stocks: BRAI surged 29%, CHRN jumped 20% and VRT rose 15%, offset by steep drops in AZUL (-24.6%) and MSGK (-19.7%). Overall the overnight picture was a mixed‑risk environment with a slight tilt toward risk‑on sentiment.
